title: Turkey Croatian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with turkey, Croatian sausage, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the Croatian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, bay leaves, and browned sausage back to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
